prompts.prompt: Elasticsearch 8.14 introduced Better Binary Quantization for dense vectors. Roughly what memory reduction factor does BBQ provide compared to unquantized vectors? Answer with the approximate multiplier.
prompts.source: plugins/database/skills/elasticsearch/references/versions/8.x.md - kNN evolution across 8.x table: 8.14 BBQ (Better Binary Quantization) for ~32x memory reduction.

prompts.prompt: In Elasticsearch 9.x logsdb index mode, what is the default value of the ignore_above setting applied to keyword fields? Answer with the exact number.
prompts.source: plugins/database/skills/elasticsearch/references/versions/9.x.md - Logsdb mode features: ignore_above for keywords -- Keyword fields have a default ignore_above: 8191 to prevent excessively long values.

prompts.prompt: What is the recommended target size range, in gigabytes, for a single Elasticsearch shard? Answer with both numbers.
prompts.source: plugins/database/skills/elasticsearch/SKILL.md - Index Architecture (Shards, Replicas, Segments) section: Target 10-50GB per shard, and avoid exceeding 20 shards per GB of heap.
